_doc: The men's swallow-tail flintlocks (#58): read by src/smyana/guns.lobster (the sim: aim and reload times) and src/smyana/gunfire.lobster (what is seen and heard). Times in seconds. The rifle's own numbers (range, damage, the reload of 18 s) are in men.json; reload_jitter_s is added to each reload, so a full reload is 18 to 23 s. aim_s: from being told to fire to the first shot, each man his own. hang_s: from the lock falling to the charge going off (the flash in the pan, then the bang); hang_fire: one shot in so many hangs much longer. far_tiles: a shot this far from the middle of the view is heard as a far one. places: what kind of place each map is for the echo (sound/flintlock.py's wood, valley, gorge, open). air: how long the smoke hangs there and how fast it drifts, tiles a second (the wood is still, the ridge windy). reload: when in it each sound comes (a share of the reload), and ram: the share of it he spends ramming (the rod up and down).
